about_short_description.short_description: AI-powered Arabic voice and customer experience solutions for enterprise

product.name: Ziila
product.description: An enterprise Arabic voice agent that handles inbound and outbound customer interactions across more than 25 dialects, including service automation, lead engagement, and agent assistance.

product.name: intellaCX
product.description: A conversation analytics platform that transcribes and evaluates customer interactions, providing sentiment, intent, compliance, performance, friction-point, and emerging-topic analysis.

product.name: intellaVX
product.description: An Arabic speech-to-text API that transcribes speech across more than 25 dialects for enterprise voice applications, analytics, and customer-service workflows.

product.name: intellaMX
product.description: An AI media transcription, translation, and subtitling service for producing Arabic and English captions and localized media content while accounting for regional Arabic dialects.
